catalog.standard_title: Classification and Safety Criteria for Raw Materials and Finished Cosmetic Formulations
catalog.scheme: Scheme I (ISI Mark) / CDSCO Cosmetics Registration
catalog.scope: Regulates permissible colorants, preservatives, and limits heavy metals (lead, arsenic, mercury) in cosmetics.
catalog.key_clauses: IS 4707-1 (Prohibited raw materials), IS 4707-2 (Permitted colorants and UV filters)

catalog.standard_title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement
catalog.scope: Regulates yield strength, elongation, chemical composition (carbon, sulfur, phosphorus), and bend testing for construction steel.
catalog.key_clauses: Clause 8.1 (Chemical Composition limits), Clause 9.2 (Tensile and Proof Stress Testing)

catalog.standard_title: Ordinary Portland Cement (33, 43, 53 Grade) & Portland Pozzolana Cement
catalog.scope: Specifies compressive strength (at 3, 7, and 28 days), setting time, soundness, and chemical composition.
catalog.key_clauses: Clause 6 (Compressive Strength testing), Clause 7 (Soundness by Le Chatelier method)

catalog.standard_title: Protective Helmets for Two-Wheeler Riders - Specification
catalog.scope: Mandatory for all two-wheeler helmets sold in India. Specifies maximum helmet weight (1.2 kg), impact absorption, and retention strap strength.
catalog.key_clauses: Clause 9.1 (Impact Absorption test), Clause 9.2 (Rigidity test), Clause 9.3 (Retention system)

catalog.standard_title: Sports Footwear, Safety Footwear & General Purpose Shoes
catalog.scope: Mandatory Quality Control Order for all footwear manufacturers and importers. Regulates sole bonding, tear strength, and chemical safety.
catalog.key_clauses: Clause 5 (Upper and Outsole adhesion test), Clause 6 (Abrasion resistance)

catalog.standard_title: Secondary Cells and Batteries Containing Alkaline or Other Non-Acid Electrolytes (Portable applications & EVs)
catalog.scope: Mandatory safety tests: overcharge, external short-circuit, thermal abuse, drop test, and crush resistance.
catalog.key_clauses: Clause 7.2 (Thermal Abuse test at 130°C), Clause 7.3 (External Short-Circuit test)

catalog.standard_title: Crystalline Silicon Terrestrial Photovoltaic (PV) Modules - Design Qualification and Safety
catalog.scheme: Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS - Scheme II under MNRE)
catalog.scope: Specifies outdoor exposure, damp-heat testing, electrical insulation, and hail impact resistance for solar panels.
catalog.key_clauses: Clause 10.11 (Damp Heat test: 85°C/85% RH for 1000h), Clause 10.17 (Hail test)

catalog.scope: Specifies bursting pressure, safety valve release mechanism (must operate before 2x working pressure), and container material safety.
catalog.key_clauses: Clause 8.1 (Operating pressure test), Clause 8.2 (Safety relief pressure test), Clause 8.3 (Hydraulic proof test)

catalog.standard_title: PVC Insulated Cables for Working Voltages up to and Including 1100 V
catalog.scope: Specifies conductor resistance, insulation thickness, spark testing, flammability, and high-voltage withstand.
catalog.key_clauses: Clause 9.1 (Conductor resistance), Clause 9.3 (Spark test during extrusion)

catalog.standard_title: Surgical Face Masks & Respiratory Protective Devices (Particulate Filters)
catalog.scheme: Scheme I (ISI Mark - Voluntary/Public Health Procurement)
catalog.scope: Specifies Bacterial Filtration Efficiency (BFE >= 95%), differential pressure (breathability), and splash resistance.
catalog.key_clauses: Clause 5.2 (Bacterial Filtration Efficiency test), Clause 5.3 (Breathability Delta P)
